title: 第二十一章 烈焰神掌一掌解决第二十二章 一招之内分出生死
slug: 修炼一天抵十年莫欺老年穷
lines: 林玄眼神冰冷，就这么单手提着这位青年的身躯，一步步向外走去。
方家兄弟及方栋，全都脸色震惊，跟在后面。
太生猛了！
这位老将军太生猛了！
不愧是化劲高手啊！
但是秘武的宗师，实力应该也不弱吧？
这注定是一场龙争虎斗！
他们不敢跟太紧，担心会被天下武会的盯上，而是全都离得远远的，吊在后方。
整个街道很快哗然。
所有的贩夫走卒都清晰地看到了这一幕，纷纷露出惊色，连忙回头。
“我去，那好像是那位老将军！”
“真的是他，和报纸上大差不差！”
“他手里提的什么人？”
“那好像也是一位秘武高手！”
人群哗然。
所有人都不敢置信，看着这一切，而后迅速跟了过去。
只见林玄提着青年，在其一脸痛苦的指引下，一路向着远处的一处大楼走去。
灌云楼。
津沽市新兴的一处西式五层小洋楼。
通体洁白色泽，拱形窗户，铸铁雕花阳台，与四周建筑物截然不同。
此时此刻。
大楼之内，宽敞的厅堂中。
数十位记者、摄影师，正围着一张长桌。
长桌中间，一个四十出头的中年男子正襟危坐，身穿暗红色锦袍，袖口绣着火焰纹路。
他双手放在桌上，十指修长，指甲修剪得整整齐齐。
正是‘烈焰神掌’傅剑秋。
同时也是【天下武会】津沽分会的元老之一。
秘武宗师！
据说已至‘淬血’境界，一掌拍出，掌风灼热如同烈焰，能将铁板也给轻而易举的烧穿开来。
这正是他‘烈焰神掌’名称的由来。
在他的左右两侧，各自站着几位天下武会的核心弟子，有男有女，年纪都在二三十岁左右，双臂环抱，一脸傲然。
毫不疑问。
他们正在召开记者招待会。
之前怎么丢掉的颜面，他们此刻会怎么找回来。
“傅前辈，听说那个前朝老将很有可能也是一位化劲高手，传统武道中能够练出化劲的，算是凤毛麟角了吧？”
一位记者询问。
“传统武道，乃时代糟粕，纵然化劲又怎样，终究是威力有限，夏国想要强盛，必须要走秘武之路，要与万国相通，才是正道。”
content_en:
Lin Xuan's eyes were cold, and he held the young man's body with one hand and walked out step by step.
The Fang brothers and Fang Dong all looked shocked and followed behind.
So fierce!
This old general is so fierce!
He is indeed a master of energy transformation!
But the master of secret martial arts should not be weak, right?
This is destined to be a battle between dragons and tigers!
They didn't dare to follow too closely for fear of being targeted by the World Martial Arts Association, but they all stayed far away and hung behind.
The whole street was soon in an uproar.
All the traders and lackeys clearly saw this scene, and they all looked shocked and turned around quickly.
"That's..."
"Let me go, that seems to be the old general!"
"It's really him, he's very different from the one in the newspaper!"
"Who is he holding in his hand?"
"That seems to be a master of secret martial arts too!"
The crowd was in an uproar.
Everyone looked at all this in disbelief, and then quickly followed.
I saw Lin Xuan carrying the young man and walking towards a building in the distance under his guidance with a painful look on his face.
Guanyun Tower.
A new Western-style five-story Western-style building in Jingu City.
With its pure white color, arched windows, and cast-iron carved balconies, it is completely different from the surrounding buildings.
At this moment.
Inside the building, in the spacious hall.
Dozens of reporters and photographers were gathered around a long table.
In the middle of the long table, a middle-aged man in his early forties sat upright, wearing a dark red brocade robe with flame patterns embroidered on the cuffs.
He put his hands on the table, his fingers were long and his nails were neatly manicured.
It was Fu Jianqiu, the ‘Flame Divine Palm’.
He is also one of the elders of the Jingu branch of [Tianxia Martial Arts Association].
Master of Secret Martial Arts!
It is said that it has reached the realm of 'tempering blood', and when it is struck with a palm, the wind of the palm is as hot as a raging flame, and can easily burn through an iron plate.
This is the origin of his name "Flame Divine Palm".
On his left and right sides, stood several core disciples of the Tianxia Martial Arts Association, both men and women, all in their twenties and thirties, with their arms folded and their faces proud.
No doubt about it.
They are holding a press conference.
How will they get back the face they lost before?
"Senior Fu, I heard that the veteran from the previous dynasty is probably also a master of Huajin. Those who can practice Huajin in traditional martial arts are very rare, right?"
one reporter asked.
"Traditional martial arts are the dregs of the times. No matter how powerful they are, their power is limited after all. If the Xia Kingdom wants to be strong, it must follow the path of secret martial arts. It must be connected with all nations. This is the right way."
title_en: Chapter 21: The Divine Flame Palm solves the problem with one strike Chapter 22: Separate life and death in one move
